## August 01, 2025

## RBI approves the voluntary amalgamation of New India Co-operative Bank Ltd.,

## Mumbai with Saraswat Co-operative Bank Ltd., Mumbai

The Reserve Bank of India, in exercise of the powers conferred under sub-section

(4) of Section 44A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, has sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation of New India Co-operative Bank Ltd., Mumbai with Saraswat Co-operative Bank Ltd., Mumbai. The Scheme will come into force with effect from August 04, 2025 (Monday). All the branches of New India Co- operative Bank Ltd., Mumbai will function as branches of Saraswat Co-operative Bank Ltd., Mumbai with effect from August 04, 2025.
## (Puneet Pancholy)
